name: Early-life welcome
objective: Cut churn in the first months
target_rule: Month 2 of service and first-month usage under 60% of the plan's typical
offer: Setup tips and a usage check call

name: Rebuy reminder
target_rule: Monthly-package customers who were late at least once in the last 3 months
offer: Reminder 3 days before the package expires

name: Payment recovery
target_rule: Postpaid customers 5 to 30 days past due
offer: Reminder call and a payment link

name: Save offer
target_rule: Active customers with a risk flag (late payment, low or falling usage, open complaint), up to 120 per month

name: 5G upgrade
target_rule: 4G customers whose home now has 5G coverage, not contacted in the last 3 months, up to 150 per month
offer: Free 5G device swap with a 5G plan
